_comment: Regex patches applied to the downloaded client bundle (build/script.js)
before it runs. Keyed to the minified client build (currently v3.2.13);
patterns are JavaScript RegExp; non-matching ones are skipped with a
warning. Each entry: { file, find, replace, note }.

patches.note: Expose the webpack module registry as window.singletons. Harmless; enables later hooks.

Guard toggleClassName against a null rootElement. On desktop there is no phone notch, so displayNotch()->toggleClassName() runs on a UI wrapper whose rootElement is null and throws during resize. Also protects any other null-rootElement toggle.

Persist the Haapi key to localStorage (save:true) so the session survives restarts. loginWithWebAuth calls setHaapiKey without the save flag, so HAAPI_KEY/HAAPI_REFRESH_TOKEN are never written and the login is lost on relaunch.

Make window resize actually resize the game. updateScreen() caches viewportWidth/Height (viewportWidth=viewportWidth||clientWidth) because the client assumes a device screen never changes size (isDevice=isIOS||isAndroid, which we spoof). Removing the cache makes _resizeUi() (which we drive on window resize in fixes.js) recompute from the current clientWidth/clientHeight.

Remove the black bars around the map on desktop. The isometric camera computes this.minZoom=Math.min(Math.max(fillW,fillH),this.maxZoom) — the most zoomed-out that still fills the view, CLAMPED to maxZoom. On a window larger than the map at maxZoom the clamp caps minZoom below the fill zoom, so the map can't zoom in enough and leaves side/top black bars. Dropping the clamp (minZoom=Math.max(fillW,fillH)) lets it always fill. Mirrors a known upstream regex.json fix: ["Math.min(Math.max((\\w),(\\w)),this.maxZoom)" -> "Math.max($1,$2)"]. Matches once (the minZoom clamp); the minZoom/currentZoom clamps have non-\w args and are left intact.

Switch the menu dock (bottom=portrait vs right=landscape) by window shape on every relayout. The client derives the dock from the persisted `bottomMenuBar` game-option, defaulted ONCE at init from the boot aspect ratio (screenWidth/screenHeight<=IPAD_SCREEN_RATIO=1.5) and never recomputed on resize, so maximizing a portrait-shaped window never flips the dock. _resizeUi (which we drive on resize/maximize) reads q.bottomMenuBar right here; recompute it from the current window aspect first. Direct field-set (not changeValue) on purpose: avoids re-emitting bottomMenuBar (whose only listener is _resizeUi itself) and avoids persisting a shape-derived value over the user's saved pref. IPAD_SCREEN_RATIO=1.5: ratio<=1.5 -> bottom (portrait) dock, ratio>1.5 -> right (landscape) dock.
Make the client's target FPS configurable (window.__dtdSettings.fps, which defaults to the monitor's refresh rate) instead of hard-capping at 60.
Make WebGL anti-aliasing configurable (window.__dtdSettings.antialias) — the client hard-disables it.
Make the render pixel-ratio cap configurable (window.__dtdSettings.pixelRatio). The client caps PIXEL_RATIO at 2; this lets high-DPI displays render sharper (or lower for performance).
